influenza vaccination of HIV‐1 infected individuals should be avoided.
influenza vaccination in HIV+ individuals is safe and should be encouraged.

influenza vaccination can lead to an increase in HIV‐1 replication in HIV+ individuals and that this increase may be related to the magnitude of the initial viraemia.
